text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон gathers all her fans for a
mini
performance and an important
announcement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She declares her intent to win every dirt
race she
enters, including the
end-of-year Tokyo
Daishoten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her proclamation to become the
undisputed
champion of the dirt gets
everyone talking, but
her friend Eishin
Flash points out that the plan
seems out
of character.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Before we can find out what that really
means,
our schedule becomes swamped
with interviews
for Смарт Фалкон.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
